item.title: Bob Weir, Grateful Dead Founding Member, Dies at 78 - Best Classic Bands
item.description: Bob Weir, who co-founded the Grateful Dead in 1965 and remained at the band's forefront throughout its 30-year run, has died.

item.title: Finding a ‘Pearl’–Janis Joplin’s Last Hurrah - Best Classic Bands
item.description: It remains her most fully realized record, fronting the best band she would ever lead on her strongest set of material.

item.title: Tributes For Grateful Dead Mainstay Bob Weir: 'We Will Miss You' - Best Classic Bands
item.description: Following the death of Bob Weir on January 10, 2026, fellow musicians began posting tributes to the Grateful Dead mainstay.

item.title: Listen to the Steve Miller Band's Live Reggae Version of 'The Joker' - Best Classic Bands
item.description: The concert captures the band at their peak, with such favorites as "Rock'n Me," "Jet Airliner" and "Fly Like an Eagle"

item.title: Radio Hits in January 1969: Don't Break My Heart - Best Classic Bands
item.description: Seven months before the Woodstock festival, future classic rock hits from CCR and the Doors were side-by-side with songs by the Bee Gees, Sammy and Sly.

item.title: Elton John's 'Tumbleweed Connection': Raising the Stakes - Best Classic Bands
item.description: The musical language that would define the Elton John and Bernie Taupin writing partnership is present on Tumbleweed Connection

item.title: James Taylor Announces 2026 Tour - Best Classic Bands
item.description: James Taylor has announced 2026 tour dates with his All-Star Band, including 29 shows in major cities across the U.S., and overseas.

item.title: Poco’s Country-Rock Legacy: “Deliverin’,” With a Gallop - Best Classic Bands
item.description: With its stellar vocal harmonies and instrumental dexterity, the album established Poco for decades to come and drew a blueprint for country-rock's future.

item.title: John Mellencamp Sets 2026 'Dancing Words' Tour - Best Classic Bands
item.description: John Mellencamp has announced a 2026 summer tour, "Dancing Words Tour — The Greatest Hits," across 19 U.S. cities, marking the first time he will be performing all his most beloved songs in a single night, some of which haven’t been played live in many years.

item.title: Trailer is Shared for Paul McCartney's Post-Beatles 'Man on the Run' Documentary - Best Classic Bands
item.description: The film comes from Academy Award winning director Morgan Neville (20 Feet from Stardom).
